parse.title: Bodily pressures
parse.wikitext:
<onlyinclude>'''Bodily pressures''' can be described as the physical experience of spontaneous pressures across differing parts of the body. These can occur as static and fixed in their location or they can occur at seemingly random varying points across the body. Depending on the intensity of the sensation, this can result in pressures which range from neutral to extremely uncomfortable in their experience.

Bodily pressures are most commonly induced under the influence of [[dosage#common|heavy]] [[dosage|dosages]] of [[stimulating]] [[psychedelic|psychedelics]], such as [[2C-E]], [[DPT]], and [[5-MeO-DMT]].  
</onlyinclude>
